packageRules.description: Hold chi below v5.3: chi v5.3 changes the route tree that the upstream route tooling (route inventory, offline-routes, jellycompat route manifest) reads, failing TestOfflineRouteSet and TestMediaRouteManifest. Lift together with the huma rule once upstream silo-server moves to chi v5.3.
Hold huma below v2.39: huma v2.39+ requires chi >= v5.3, which is held above.
